<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Store a secret in the daemon's vault. The value comes from --from-pass (first line), or is typed at the terminal without echo, or is read from stdin. Secrets can't be read back.

## Usage

```text
chainmail secret set <name> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
# typed at the terminal without echo
chainmail secret set accounts/work
chainmail secret set accounts/work --from-pass mail/work
chainmail secret set oauth_clients/google --from-pass google/oauth-client
```

## Flags

```text
      --from-pass string   read the secret from this pass entry (first line)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
